column_description: Unique identifier for each user action.
ID of the user performing the action. may be NULL.
Type of action (e.g., create, update, delete). always exactly one of 'create', 'update', 'delete'. may be NULL.
Details of the action performed. may be NULL.
Date and time the action was performed. may be NULL.
ID of the scene if the action is related to a scene. may be NULL.
ID of the object if the action is related to an object. may be NULL.
IP address from which the action was performed. may be NULL.
User agent string of the device used to perform the action. may be NULL.
